# Lab 9.3: BigQuery DataFrames ML & AI

## What We Are Going to Do
Train and evaluate a model with `bigframes.ml` using scikit-learn-style code, then call BigQuery AI functions from Python.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Prepare the penguins data.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • PYTHON
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">import bigframes.pandas as bpd
from bigframes.ml.model_selection import train_test_split

df = bpd.read_gbq("bigquery-public-data.ml_datasets.penguins").dropna()
X = df[["species", "island", "culmen_length_mm", "culmen_depth_mm", "flipper_length_mm", "sex"]]
y = df[["body_mass_g"]]
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.2)</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] Train and evaluate.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • PYTHON
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">from bigframes.ml.linear_model import LinearRegression
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X_train, y_train)
model.score(X_test, y_test)</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The training runs as a BigQuery ML job.

3. **[Console] Predict and save the model.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • PYTHON
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">model.predict(X_test).head()
model.to_gbq("lab09.penguins_weight_lr", replace=True)</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[Console] Call AI functions from Python.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • PYTHON
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">import bigframes.bigquery as bbq

news = bpd.read_gbq("bigquery-public-data.bbc_news.fulltext").head(20)
news["is_about_money"] = bbq.ai.if_(("This news story is about money or the economy: ", news["body"]))
news["summary"] = bbq.ai.generate(("Summarise in one sentence: ", news["body"])).struct.field("result")
news[["title", "is_about_money", "summary"]].to_pandas()</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[CLI] Confirm the model in BigQuery.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq ls --models lab09
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'SELECT * FROM ML.EVALUATE(MODEL lab09.penguins_weight_lr)'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| API | Same shape as scikit-learn |
| Training | Runs inside BigQuery ML |
| Model | Saved as `lab09.penguins_weight_lr` |
| AI functions | `ai.if_` and `ai.generate` from Python |
